content: I worry her actions will bring unexpected things to bear upon Terra. My intent was to stop her before then... but we were one step too slow.

content: On Terra today, interfering in such things is no longer easy. Civilization is much more expansive than I thought.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]You may suggest those aboard Rhodes Island today, Amiya, Closure, the hunters with ties to Ægir... They know a great deal already, which has helped to resolve their own issues.

content: You may suggest those aboard Rhodes Island today, Amiya, Closure, the hunters with ties to Ægir... They know a great deal already, which has helped to resolve their own issues.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]But when you plough the fields, you never pay mind to why the horizons form as clouds, rain and lightning, yet perhaps you may want to know when the next storm will come.

content: But when you plough the fields, you never pay mind to why the horizons form as clouds, rain and lightning, yet perhaps you may want to know when the next storm will come.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The arrogant acts of noble politicians versus repeated Catastrophe, the forecasted yield of crops versus new tax levies, these are things that ground life. The reality is, countless have no regard for even that much.

content: The arrogant acts of noble politicians versus repeated Catastrophe, the forecasted yield of crops versus new tax levies, these are things that ground life. The reality is, countless have no regard for even that much.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]They simply do not care for the fates of others.

content: They simply do not care for the fates of others.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]From a Terran's point of view, even if they did choose to believe such far-flung knowledge and information, what could they do about it? What use would it be?
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: From a Terran's point of view, even if they did choose to believe such far-flung knowledge and information, what could they do about it? What use would it be?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The wise that take note of all around them, those bare few, are the only ones able to maintain their thought.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The wise that take note of all around them, those bare few, are the only ones able to maintain their thought.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]And the rest, when faced with things that outstrip their comprehension, more than often opt to laugh it off or persecute it, so as to protect their comfortable bubbles of ignorance from any outside challenge.

content: And the rest, when faced with things that outstrip their comprehension, more than often opt to laugh it off or persecute it, so as to protect their comfortable bubbles of ignorance from any outside challenge.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]They are no more than 'lamentable,' but the truth grows ever further because of them.

content: They are no more than 'lamentable,' but the truth grows ever further because of them.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]'Breakthrough.' A neutral descriptor, but you still unconsciously believe that the 'sky' is something that should have no limit.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: 'Breakthrough.' A neutral descriptor, but you still unconsciously believe that the 'sky' is something that should have no limit.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]To any scholar across the land, all that happens high in the sky is unsolved natural phenomena, just as Catastrophe and the ocean are.

content: To any scholar across the land, all that happens high in the sky is unsolved natural phenomena, just as Catastrophe and the ocean are.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]They will puzzle, probe at its inner workings, use their knowledge and philosophies to dissect it all—they will research all the phenomena of the sky, never considering that 'the sky should not be this way.'
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: They will puzzle, probe at its inner workings, use their knowledge and philosophies to dissect it all—they will research all the phenomena of the sky, never considering that 'the sky should not be this way.'

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Countless children have flown for it in their dreams, and they too quickly realize, the sky is not something that can be freely soared through.

content: Countless children have flown for it in their dreams, and they too quickly realize, the sky is not something that can be freely soared through.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Drones and vehicle altitudes have been rigorously restricted, and the spreading of every fowlbeast's wings is constrained by instinct.

content: Drones and vehicle altitudes have been rigorously restricted, and the spreading of every fowlbeast's wings is constrained by instinct.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]This is the state of common sense upon this land. No one has ever questioned the rising of the sun and setting of the moon, and no one has ever questioned how it is all that all beings come to grow.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]But Kristen has steadfastly chosen 'not to believe,' just as poets do not believe that dreams are fiction.

content: But Kristen has steadfastly chosen 'not to believe,' just as poets do not believe that dreams are fiction.

raw: [name="Ho'olheyak"]I want to see how she ends, to guess her true intentions, to unearth her legacy. And then, I'll snatch away every last little thing that made up her mind when she ridiculed me.
